page_title: v0 by Vercel - Build Full-Stack Web Apps with AI

sources.entry: v0 - AI-powered UI component generator by Vercel. #free

summary.name: v0
summary.one_liner: v0 by Vercel is an AI assistant that generates full-stack web applications from prompts and publishes them as live websites.
use_cases: Generate a working web application from a text prompt
Prototype and publish a website quickly
Push AI-generated code to a GitHub repository
Start a site from ready-made templates
Create and reuse a design system across projects
Build and deploy sites from a phone
summary.what_it_does: The page describes v0 as a prompt-based builder that generates working applications and publishes them as live websites. It says code can be synced to a GitHub repository and that the tool integrates with third-party apps and APIs. Users can fine-tune designs with visual controls and a live preview, start from templates, and define colors, typography and styles as a reusable design system. It also states that v0 plans tasks and connects to databases while building, and offers one-click deployment to Vercel.
notable: Syncs generated code directly to GitHub repositories
Visual design mode with live preview
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; a listing describes it as free, but this is not confirmed by the page itself
Mobile app is listed for iOS only; no Android mention on the page
